io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.authentication: API key only: the human signs up, signs in and creates a read or manage key on the website account page of the chosen region. The MCP server never accepts passwords, verification codes or ordinary access/refresh tokens and has no proof-of-work step.

dataResidency.selection: Before the human creates an account on the website or configures an API key, ask where they want their account data stored. Use the matching endpoint; do not infer residency from language, IP or proximity. Existing accounts must use their original region, and an API key only works on the region whose account page created it. Never forward credentials or retry an API key across regions. Accounts, networks and balances are independent; switching endpoints does not migrate data. The MCP host must select or reconnect to the chosen remote before sending the API key.

environmentVariables.description: Default store for every tool call (default: "default").
environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_USER_ID

environmentVariables.description: Engine to read with: tablet-2 (default — same token price as tablet-1, and the one that serves photos and re-ask), tablet-1, scroll-1, scroll-1.2, or scroll-2.
environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Default re-ask passes for search, 0-3 (default 0). Each pass is another engine call and is billed for what it delivers; the agent can raise it per call.
environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_VERIFY

environmentVariables.description: Default photo results per search, 0-5 (default 0). Zero because these rows ride on every search; the view_image tool fetches the one picture that is wanted.
environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_MAX_IMAGES

environmentVariables.description: A different API host. Leave unset for the default.
environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in ms (default 20000). A stalled API then fails in-band instead of hanging the host.
environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for read-only mode: only the tools that read are registered, no write or delete tools.
environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to let tools take a user_id argument (multi-store). Default: every call is pinned to WONTOPOS_USER_ID.
environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_ALLOW_STORE_OVERRIDE

environmentVariables.description: Serve over HTTP on this port instead of stdio, for hosts that cannot spawn a local process. Requires WONTOPOS_HTTP_TOKEN.
environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Bearer token every HTTP request must carry. Required whenever WONTOPOS_HTTP_PORT is set.
environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Interface to bind in HTTP mode. Default 127.0.0.1 (this machine only).
environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Host header values to accept in HTTP mode, for a tunnel that forwards its own public name. Loopback and the bind address are always accepted; anything else is refused 403.
environmentVariables.name: WONTOPOS_HTTP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
